text:
The count rate measured near a radioactive source drops from 542 counts per minute to
94 counts per minute in 12 hours. The background count remains constant at 30 counts per
minute.
What is the half-life of the source?
A
2 hours
B
3 hours
C
4 hours
D
8 hours
subject: Physics
